motivation: G3.7 establishes a real re-entry effect but exact DP dominates efficiency when the complete compatible model fiber and response map are explicitly enumerable.
hard_condition: Neither a complete hypothesis/model fiber nor an exact response table is supplied. The system must construct, prune and expand its belief support online while choosing interventions.
lanes: finite hidden support discovered from observations
open-world novelty: truth absent from initial support
gauge/null lane where observational equivalence survives every admissible intervention
mandatory_baselines: neural amortized belief-state baseline under matched budget
primary_endpoints: policy regret against oracle enumerated-fiber ceiling
